meta.title: Analog Clock — Online Clock with Hour and Minute Hands
meta.description: A free online analog clock with moving hour and minute hands. View the current time in a classic clock face format.

howItWorks: The analog clock reads the current time from your device's system clock.
The hour and minute hands rotate based on the current hours and minutes.
The clock face updates smoothly every second to reflect the exact time.
howToUse: Open the Analog Clock tool — it starts automatically.
Read the time from the clock face with hour and minute hands.
Keep the tab open for a continuous real-time display.

faq.question: Does the analog clock show seconds?
faq.answer: The analog clock displays hour and minute hands. A second hand may be shown depending on the display mode.

faq.question: Can I use this for presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. The analog clock is great for classrooms and presentations. Use full-screen mode for a larger display.

faq.question: Is the time based on my timezone?
faq.answer: Yes. The analog clock uses your device's local timezone settings to display the correct time.

examples.description: The analog clock shows the current time with rotating hands.
